issue.title: Documentation on build flags is gone
issue.body:
## Checklist

* [x] Are you running the latest v3 release? The list of releases is [here](https://github.com/urfave/cli/releases).
* [x] Did you check the manual for your release? The v3 manual is [here](https://github.com/urfave/cli/blob/main/docs/v3/index.md).
* [x] Did you perform a search about this feature? Here's the [GitHub guide](https://help.github.com/en/github/managing-your-work-on-github/using-search-to-filter-issues-and-pull-requests) about searching.

## What problem does this solve?

`v1` and `v2` had build flags to turn off unneeded features and reduce binary sizes.

- https://github.com/urfave/cli/pull/1375
- https://github.com/urfave/cli/pull/1604
- https://github.com/urfave/cli/pull/1847

But the web site - https://cli.urfave.org/ - is silent about them, and migration guide also doesn't mention they were removed.

## Solution description

Document what happened to the build options. Are they gone? Can they be implemented again? Is it only documentation that is missing?

comments.author: abitrolly
comments.body: Automatic dead code elimination works better with external packages? https://cli.urfave.org/v3/examples/completions/shell-completions/ says the completion is enabled by setting `EnableShellCompletion: true`. If DCO is not smart enough to detect the dead branch with `false`, what will change if the completion is moved to the separate package?
